column7: Verifies the Ed25519 public signature over the payload bytes; refuses an unknown kid, a bad signature or profile, an outer receipt that differs, and a result that mismatches or is unhashable
Resolves the Ed25519 seed and kid from the overlay; refuses a malformed seed or kid and an attestation collision with a value-free error, absent or blank resolves to none
Loads one JWK or a keys set; refuses malformed shape, duplicate kid, non-Ed25519 key, bad x, private member, and missing or malformed kid
Installs the public signer at startup when stamping is on; a malformed seed propagates and refuses startup
